Resolves #21141

The examples section now knows the 22 groups of map v2, and a record can show in a second group. On today's catalog, 14 groups publish in production instead of five families.

- **Groups are data.** `familyDefinitions` holds Featured and the 22 bound groups, each with its band, title, path and icon. `Portal.model.Example#alsoIn` lists the other groups a record shows in. A group's store holds its home records and the records whose `alsoIn` names it.
- **One publication rule.** `Portal.model.Example.publishes(record, mode)` holds when a record names a cover and the build can open it: not `hidden`, the mode not in `hiddenIn`, a URL for the mode. The group stores, the tab publication and `Portal.view.examples.List` read it. `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` applies the same rule for `dist_prod`, since a build script cannot import the class, and the parity spec holds both to one result.
- **Tabs follow the build.** The view binds `catalogMode`; a build selection moves every list's mode filter and republishes the groups. Dev mode cannot open `liquid-glass`, so More components has no tab there. An open group stays selected when a tab is inserted or removed before it, and yields to Featured when it loses its last card.
- **The data pass.** 23 records move to their home group by the table, and 11 records get the listed `alsoIn` values. Search titles cover the 13 new groups in `EXAMPLE_FAMILY_SEO` and in `Portal.service.Seo#routeTitles`, and `seo.json` gains their routes.

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium: `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` walks the 15 tabs and the four builds, 10/10) → L2 required (the ACs are catalog, publication and route rules that unit arms read directly). No residuals.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Captions for nine records.** helix, covid-helix, gallery, covid-gallery, tab-container, state-provider, dialog-drag-drop, offscreen-canvas and liquid-glass were Featured-only and had no `feature` or `lookFor`. They now publish in a group, and the catalog spec requires both on every card. Each caption was written from the example's source. @neo-fable-clio then followed every `lookFor` in the running examples ([her read](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21162#issuecomment-6926342053)). Six held. gallery, state-provider and covid-gallery now carry her corrected steps, and their labels are checked in the examples' sources. The state group's search description follows the new state-provider `feature` in `seo.json`.
- **The caption rule** now covers every record that publishes a card, not every record with a family: after the data pass every record has one. realworld and realworld-v2 stay hidden in every mode and carry none.
- **Featured's store** filters by the build mode too, so one rule governs every list. Its cards are unchanged, since `List` already hid the same records; its store holds 27 in ESM and Dev mode.
- **`List` keeps the Portal's self-link clause**, as said on the ticket: it depends on the running page, not the catalog.
- **`Portal.service.Seo#routeTitles`** repeats each group path with its search title, the mirror #21129 introduced for the SPA window title; `Seo.spec.mjs` holds it to `EXAMPLE_FAMILY_SEO`. The 13 new titles are for the SEO steward to read.
- **An open group keeps its tab across a build switch.** @neo-gpt-emmy's Chromium check of `ef4d8e19b9` found the problem: open Multi-Window, choose Dev mode, then Production. Production re-inserted More components before Multi-Window, `activeIndex` stayed on the inserted tab, and the selected tab no longer matched `#/examples/multi-window`. `publishFamilies()` now resolves the open route to its new index after reconciling.
- **The Examples bar overflows on desktop.** Featured and the 14 groups need more than 1920 px, so the bar keeps its overflow control, and its menu holds the groups the rail cannot show. The control now sits in the bar's action rail beside the build menu instead of floating. How a visitor moves between groups is #21130's question.
- **Multi-Window** shows six covered cards, not seven: `dock-choreography` moves home to Dashboard & Docking, and the table gives it no `alsoIn`.
- **Sentence and tile per group** are documented as optional definition keys; the design seat has not posted them yet, and this PR takes them when they arrive.

## Test Evidence

- **Data:** after the pass, every record's family is a defined group; the groups with a card are 14 in `dist_prod`, `dist_esm` and `dist_dev` and 13 in `devmode`; Featured holds 28 in production.
- **Mutation controls**, each in a scratch worktree:
  - `belongsTo()` without `alsoIn`: 12 controller arms fail.
  - `publishes()` without the mode clauses: 9 fail, the Dev mode set and the build switch among them.
  - no `afterSetCatalogMode()` hook: the build-switch arm fails.
  - `seoJson.mjs` without `alsoIn`: the parity arm and the `alsoIn` SEO arm fail.
- **Red first** for the open-tab fix: against the previous `publishFamilies()`, "an open group stays selected when a build switch inserts or removes a tab before it" fails with `/examples/components` where `/examples/multi-window` is expected; the fallback arm passes both ways.
- **Rebased onto `13626c0c1c`**, which carries #21161's 21 covers. The specs' cover counts follow it: 30 records without a cover, and Grid & Table shows all 21. `seo.json` was regenerated, so its Grid & Table description counts 21.
- **Here:** unit `apps/portal/` with `buildScripts/docs/` 218/218, `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` included; e2e `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` and `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs`'s desktop arm 11/11.
- **A floating control leaked across sections.** CI shard 2 and @neo-gpt-emmy's Chromium repro at `ce25fab825` both caught it.
  - With 15 tabs, the Examples bar keeps its overflow control at 1920 px.
  - The plugin's default control floats on `document.body`. A mount still pending when the route left the section completed afterwards, so the button stayed visible and clickable on News and opened the Examples menu.
  - The Examples bar now uses the plugin's `projectAsAction` embodiment, since it already owns an action rail (the build menu). Its control lives inside the section and leaves with it.
  - `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` keeps the Examples → News order as the guard and counts visible controls only.
  - Locally `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` passes 10/10 with the moved control. The News half runs in CI only, since News routes raise a worker error in my local tree.
  - The floating embodiment's race stays in `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs` for bars without an action rail, such as News's.
- `seo.json` is the output of `node buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs -f seo-json -o apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` on this head.
